summary: Bus turnaround at the road end with No Stopping signs; nowhere legitimate to stay.
reasons: Paved turnaround, not a parking area

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto bush to the north, but the turnaround is a campus transport hub.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide paved turnaround, but it is signed No Stopping and used by buses.
drivers.traffic: Campus road end beside the Conifer Knoll parking station entrance.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time signs at 0.7 m and 10.8 m from the kerb line.

sun_shade: Open paving with tree shade from the north and east.
